say.text: In Jumada II, 562 AH: March and April of 1167, Salah ad-Din sustained the siege of Alexandria, against Shawar and the Egyptian army.

At Bilbays, Shirkuh made peace with the Egyptians, and obtained the Franks' promise that they would leave Egypt before the end of the year. The Egyptians escorted Salah ad-Din out of Alexandria, to his uncle.
What decided the Franks to leave was the news that Nur ad-Din had invaded their country and taken the fortress of al-Munaytira.
It held me, uncle, as much as I held it. I counted the bread every morning.
That is the first thing I taught you, and the only thing you have ever done exactly as I said.
Salah ad-Din went back to Syria with Shirkuh. The month was Shawwal or Dhu'l-Qa'da, 562: August or September, 1167.
